title: FactForge Fact Audit Report
description: Authored by factforge-fact-audit, which runs after script and before script_qa - the script must read confident and fluent with zero hedging; verification happens here, as a separate post-draft pass, not during writing. unresolved_count must be 0 before script_qa may approve the script; health/medical/psychological/scientific claims left unresolved hard-block via the non-waivable UNRESOLVED_CLAIM error code.

location_ref.description: Where in script.md this claim appears (e.g. a section id).

registry_hit.description: True if fact_registry/<claim_hash>.jsonl had a non-expired verified entry, so fresh external verification was not required.
